bio.text: Diana DeGette, a fourth-generation Coloradan, represents Colorado's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.

Before being elected to Congress she was an attorney in the Denver area focused on workers' rights, and served two terms in the Colorado Legislature, including one term as Assistant Minority Leader from 1993 to 1995.
She graduated from Denver's South High School, received a B.A. from Colorado College in 1979, and earned a J.D. from New York University School of Law in 1982.
